facts.activity_file: setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: loss of containment at PSV-7101 during commissioning of replacement equipment

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-7101 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on PSV-7101 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on PSV-7101 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices. PSV-7101 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 11 October 2016 an incident occurred on PSV-7101 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during commissioning of replacement equipment, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
